gate_diagnostics.jsonl.signed_gate_note: Gate 13 routers are SIGNED residual gates (gamma_r in (-g_max,g_max)), not (0,1) convex-mixing weights -- a negative signed_branch_contribution means the branch learned to SUBTRACT from the base score, not a failure mode. See model.py's module docstring.

fields.alpha_mean: float, mean pre-activation alpha_r across relations
fields.gate_signed_mean: float, mean signed gate value g_max*tanh(alpha_r) -- can be negative
fields.gamma_displacement_mean: float, mean |gamma_r - gamma_r(0)| -- identical to gate_absolute_mean since gamma_r(0)=0 exactly
fields.branch_score_rms: float, RMS of the RAW (pre-gate) branch score s_branch
fields.signed_branch_contribution: float, mean(gamma_r * s_branch) -- SIGNED, can be negative
fields.correlation_with_base_score: float in [-1,1], Pearson correlation between the gated branch contribution and the base expert's score s_base, per query
fields.rms_contribution_ratio: float, RMS(gamma_r * s_branch) / RMS(s_total), computed on the eval batch
fields.grad_alpha_norm: float, gradient norm on the router embedding this step
